items.title: BFSI Summit 2026: 'Digital access could widen MF investor base to 200 mn'
items.description: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026, industry leaders said digital platforms, innovative SIP products, investor education and AI tools could help expand India's mutual fund base to 200 million.

items.title: Valuation of AI stocks, volatility pose risks for investors: Fund managers
items.description: Fund managers at the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit flagged AI stock valuation risks and urged investors to focus on disciplined asset allocation, long-term fundamentals amid market volatility

items.title: Investors need suitable products, not complexity, say mutual fund CEOs
items.description: Business Standard BFSI Summit: Mutual fund CEOs say smallcap valuations remain a concern, while hybrid funds and specialised investment funds could offer investors more flexibility
